svg.title: Aligned deletion evidence
svg.desc: Five deletion intervals aligned to six equal gene slots. Del 1 removes genes 1–3, Del 2 removes 2–3, Del 3 removes 2–4, Del 4 removes 3–5, and Del 5 removes 4–6. Gray shows the retained DNA and magenta marks the missing intervals.
svg.text: Gray rods = retained DNA; magenta = deleted interval
